description: This file contains utility functions related to mathematical operations used in the jwql instrument monitoring project. It includes functions for Gaussian fitting, sigma clipping, and statistical analysis of image data.

classes.name: models.Gaussian1D
classes.description: A 1D Gaussian model from astropy's modeling module used for Gaussian fitting.

classes.name: fitting.LevMarLSQFitter
classes.description: A least squares fitter from astropy's modeling module used for fitting models to data.

methods.name: double_gaussian(x, amp1, peak1, sigma1, amp2, peak2, sigma2)
methods.description: Defines the sum of two Gaussian functions for fitting purposes.

methods.name: double_gaussian_fit(x_values, y_values, input_params)
methods.description: Fits two Gaussian functions to data using curve fitting.

methods.name: gaussian1d_fit(x_values, y_values, params)
methods.description: Fits a 1D Gaussian to data, returns amplitude, peak, and width with uncertainties.

methods.name: mean_image(cube, sigma_threshold=3)
methods.description: Computes a sigma-clipped mean and standard deviation image from a stack of 2D images.

methods.name: mean_stdev(image, sigma_threshold=3)
methods.description: Calculates sigma-clipped mean and standard deviation of an array.

ctags.name: double_gaussian
ctags.pattern: /^def double_gaussian(x, amp1, peak1, sigma1, amp2, peak2, sigma2):$/
ctags.signature: (x, amp1, peak1, sigma1, amp2, peak2, sigma2)
